All,

Planning notes for this year's Foxglove Classic, our golf day for the Bayou Literacy Fund:

- Friday, June 29, at Cypress Hollow Golf Club. Shotgun start at 8:00 AM.
- 28 foursomes are signed up so far. The course can take 36.
- Lunch is by Delacroix & Sons Catering.
- The goal is $50,000. Last year we raised $43,000.

Marisol has agreed to chair this year.

Hyacinth
